externalReply.text: Leena, Northstar takes full responsibility for a smooth transition. Your field teams will have uninterrupted access through July and every record will carry forward securely. Your team will remain in control, and Northstar will handle the technical details without requiring more work from you. Nia will send a confirmation by 16:30 today and the account team looks forward to welcoming you to the new platform.
